description: Delete a folder (and its subfolders/filed rows). Only ORGANISATION is deleted - the generations, entities, sessions and images filed inside are never touched. To unlink a codex folder from a campaign workspace without deleting it, pass the grafted root's ref_row_id; deleting the codex original also removes every campaign reference to it. An Atlas place (place=true) is different: its sub-places, folders and filed things move up to its parent place, and a place a campaign links to directly cannot be deleted until that link is removed.

collection_id.description: Collection UUID (a folder id or a grafted root's ref_row_id)
